prompt: Why would a customer send an offcut?
promptZh: 客戶為什麼會寄送一塊邊料？

options.text: To have a spare stamp made from it.
options.zh: 請供應商用邊料做一個備用鋼印。
options.whyZh: 邊料是讓供應商試印的材料，不是鋼印本體的用料。

options.text: To check how the mark appears on that material.
options.zh: 確認印記在該材料上的效果。
options.whyZh: 供應商在客戶提供的材料上試印，以查看呈現效果。

options.text: To help identify the original drawing number.
options.whyZh: 再次下單時要提供原始圖號，不是靠邊料辨識。

options.text: To receive a certain number of extra stamps.
options.zh: 為了收到一定數量的額外鋼印。
options.whyZh: 三次試印是對邊料尺寸的要求，不是寄送鋼印數量。

explanationZh: 供應商在客戶提供的材料上試印，以查看呈現效果。
evidence: To see how the mark looks on your material, send an offcut big enough for three impressions.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: To see how the mark looks on your material, send an offcut big enough for three impressions.
